title: Çocukluk arkadaşı

characters.KID1: a boy of about nine with short ginger hair and freckles, wearing a blue jacket
characters.KID2: a boy of about nine with curly black hair, wearing an orange sweater
characters.MAN1: a man of about thirty-five with short ginger hair and a ginger beard, wearing a blue coat
characters.MAN2: a man of about thirty-five with curly black hair, wearing an orange scarf and a grey coat

scenes.text:
Seni, sen daha "sen" olmadan tanıyan birini
en son ne zaman aradın?
scenes.prompt: On a quiet neighborhood street in autumn, {KID1} on the left and {KID2} on the right ride small bicycles side by side, laughing, golden leaves on the ground, late afternoon sun.

scenes.text:
Aynı sokakta bisiklet sürer,
aynı ağaca tırmanırdınız.
scenes.prompt: {KID1} and {KID2} sit together on a thick branch of a big old tree, smiling and looking at the sunset, autumn leaves falling, a quiet street below.

scenes.text:
Sonra okullar, şehirler, işler
sizi yavaş yavaş ayırdı.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, on a long road that splits in two, {MAN1} walks down the left road and {MAN2} walks down the right road, seen from behind, autumn trees along both roads.

scenes.text:
Ama çocukluk lakabını hâlâ bilen
dünyadaki tek kişi o.
scenes.prompt: {MAN1} sits alone on a balcony at sunset with a cup of tea on the small table beside him, smiling softly at a memory, autumn leaves drifting past.

scenes.text:
Bazı numaralar silinmez, sadece aranmayı bekler.
Bunu çocukluk arkadaşına gönder.
scenes.prompt: {MAN1} sits on an old bench under the same big tree on the childhood street at sunset, smiling, a phone lying on the bench beside him, golden autumn leaves falling.

caption:
Onu aradın mı?

Seni lakabınla çağıran son kişi belki o. 🤍

Bunu çocukluk arkadaşına gönder.
